label: New Website Project
description: Real client build with planning artefacts and the full review loop.

tasks.title: Structure the client request
tasks.mission: Turn the request into a structured specification for a new client website. Record only facts actually present; list unknowns.

tasks.title: Requirements gap analysis
tasks.mission: Identify missing requirements, contradictions and risky assumptions; state safe defaults, what must be confirmed before launch, and testable acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Business and audience research
tasks.mission: Research the business (if named) and its audience: services, service area, customer questions, seasonal needs and decision criteria. Classify every claim (VERIFIED_FACT / SOURCE_DERIVED / INFERENCE / UNVERIFIED) with source ids.

tasks.title: Competitor analysis
tasks.mission: Compare public competitor patterns (structure, messaging, UX, offers, trust signals) and identify differentiation opportunities without copying.

tasks.title: Visual asset plan
tasks.mission: Define art direction and the image/asset plan (subjects, composition, licensing, alt text); placeholders with art-direction briefs where real assets are unknown.

tasks.title: Brand voice
tasks.mission: Define voice attributes, vocabulary and before/after examples appropriate to this business and audience.

tasks.title: SEO strategy
tasks.mission: Create the SEO strategy: keyword targets by intent and page, titles/meta/h1 per page, JSON-LD (placeholders for unknown business fields) and internal linking.

tasks.title: Local SEO plan
tasks.mission: Plan local SEO: service-area approach, NAP requirements, Google Business Profile alignment and local schema fields (placeholders for unknowns).

tasks.title: Project plan
tasks.mission: Create milestones, owners, dependencies, risks and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Site architecture
tasks.mission: Define pages, section hierarchy with a purpose per section, navigation, URL structure, tech approach and non-functional requirements, consistent with the blueprint.

tasks.title: Design system and layouts
tasks.mission: Create the design tokens (AA-verified colour pairs, type scale, spacing, radius, elevation), grid, component inventory and mobile/tablet/desktop layouts for every section.

tasks.title: Website copy
tasks.mission: Write all page copy per the architecture in the brand voice, including title tags and meta descriptions; placeholders for unknown facts.

tasks.title: Conversion review of copy
tasks.mission: Review the copy and structure for clarity, CTA placement and conversion friction; reject with specific rewrites if needed.

tasks.title: Motion system
tasks.mission: Define a restrained, purposeful motion system with reduced-motion fallbacks.

tasks.title: Build the website
tasks.mission: Implement the complete website as static files (every page in the blueprint, one stylesheet, minimal deferred JS, robots.txt, sitemap.xml) using the blueprint, architecture, design system, approved copy and SEO specification.

tasks.title: Design critique of the implementation
tasks.mission: Strict review of the rendered implementation (hierarchy, spacing, typography, originality, polish) against the design system and ApexWeb anti-slop rules. Reject with precise fixes if it looks generic, templated or over-decorated.

tasks.title: Independent UX review
tasks.mission: Walk the primary journeys in the blueprint and report friction with element-level fixes.

tasks.title: Independent bug hunt
tasks.mission: Find runtime errors, broken interactions and defects using the bug scan evidence.

tasks.title: Responsive verification
tasks.mission: Verify behaviour at 360/768/1440px using rendered measurements; report defects with selector, viewport and CSS fix.

tasks.title: Accessibility audit
tasks.mission: Audit against WCAG 2.2 AA using axe results and a manual review of semantics, keyboard flow and focus states.

tasks.title: Performance audit
tasks.mission: Audit loading performance using the measured mobile probe (LCP, CLS, bytes, render-blocking) and the files; give concrete fixes.

tasks.title: On-page SEO audit of the implementation
tasks.mission: Audit the built pages against the SEO strategy using the seo_audit output: metadata, headings, JSON-LD validity, internal links, sitemap/robots. Return a review with fixes.

tasks.title: Main Agent triage of review findings
tasks.mission: Consider every independent reviewer finding. Accept the ones that are evidenced and genuinely improve the result (assign each to the right specialist with the fix); reject duplicates, subjective nitpicks and anything contradicting the blueprint, with reasons.

tasks.title: Visual QA loop
tasks.mission: Render desktop, tablet and mobile, analyse screenshots and region checks, compare with the previous pass, and reject with concrete fixes until no critical or major visual issue remains.

tasks.title: Final QA and release check
tasks.mission: Run the final release checks. Approve only if there are no deterministic hard failures and no unresolved critical issues; evaluate every blueprint requirement (result.requirement_checks). Otherwise reject with the exact fixes required.

tasks.title: Handoff package documentation
tasks.mission: Write docs/HANDOFF.md (what was built, structure, how to deploy and edit, every [[PLACEHOLDER]] the client must replace, open items, configuration notes) and docs/CHANGELOG.md strictly from the task log.
